Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment primarily uses Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) to determine protein-protein interactions and structural proximity. While the protein of interest is a ubiquitin ligase, the MS assay itself is a cross-linking study (mod_tpp/XL-MS), not a diGly/ubiquitin-remnant enrichment study. Acquisition is explicitly DDA.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The dataset contains two distinct MS applications: one for cross-linking (CX-MS) using pLink 2 to identify structural constraints of TRIM72, and another for protein identification of microvesicles using Proteome Discoverer. The CX-MS component is the primary specialized workflow.
